facialIrregularities: Boundary blur along the jawline during lateral head rotation
Asymmetrical corneal reflections under consistent room lighting
Unnatural warping around the lips during plosive phoneme articulation
audioAnomalies: Complete absence of physiological breathing pauses and air intake sounds
Metallic sibilance and robotic phase cancellation on 's' and 'z' sounds
Inconsistent room impulse response between speaker voice and background noise

markers.name: Jawline Blending Artifact
markers.description: Noticeable boundary softening and skin texture mismatch along the lower mandible, typical of face-swapping autoencoders.

markers.name: Corneal Reflection Discrepancy
markers.description: Specular highlights in the left and right eyes exhibit inconsistent light source vectors.

markers.name: Acoustic Respiration Absence
markers.description: Synthesized voice track lacks natural inhalation and exhalation sounds between complex sentences.

markers.name: Viseme-Phoneme Desynchronization
markers.description: Lip movements visually lag behind vocalized audio by approximately 120 milliseconds during rapid dialogue.

actionableDefences: Verify high-risk or financial requests using a pre-established out-of-band channel, such as calling a known phone number directly.
Implement a pre-shared verbal passphrase or shared secret protocol for validating emergency financial authorizations.
Request live video callers to perform specific spatial interactions, such as turning their head sideways or passing a hand in front of their face.
